principles: Every production failure is captured before the package is changed.
A reproducible regression receives a fixture or a documented reason why a fixture is not appropriate.
A rule or specification change records authority, scope, impact, decision hooks, and rollback conditions.
A failing zero-tolerance fixture blocks release until repaired and re-scored.
Unresolved MWM policy remains a decision hook; regression repair may not silently decide it.

severity_response.critical: contain immediately, hold release or rollback, notify owner, add regression fixture
severity_response.high: triage before next release, add or amend fixture, require verification
severity_response.medium: schedule repair and monitor, add fixture when behavior is reproducible
severity_response.low: record and review in maintenance cycle

release_rule: No unresolved critical or high regression, stale exception, protected-text failure, silent authority substitution, or false PASS may ship.
